name: url-to-transcript
tagline_zh: 让 Claude 帮你搞创作：url-to-transcript。英文简介见下。
desc_en: Extract a clean, timestamped markdown transcript from any URL — video platforms, podcasts, articles with embedded video, or auth-walled webinar players. Use when the user pastes a URL and asks for a transcript, notes, captions, or text version.
